quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q backlog: Bel's backlog of orders amounted to $594.7 million at June 30, 2026, an increase of $155.6 million, or 35.4%, from December 31, 2025; over the same period backlog rose 22.2% in the Aerospace, Defense & Rugged Solutions segment and 56.0% in the Industrial Technology & Data Solutions segment (industrial, networking and data infrastructure markets).
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $594.7 million at June 30, 2026 (+35.4% from December 31, 2025); ADRS +22.2%; ITDS +56.0%

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q component supply: a surge in demand driven by AI data center buildouts has contributed to higher prices and extended lead times for certain components, including printed circuit boards (PCBs), semiconductors and capacitors; lead times for certain ICs have increased, which Bel believes is driven in part by demand related to AI-enabled applications and the supporting infrastructure. Material costs rose to 33.1% of Q2 2026 sales from 31.8%, reflecting higher purchasing volumes, higher unit input costs in certain commodities and electronic components including select supplier price increases, and increased use of third-party manufacturing for products previously made at the Pingguo facility.
